subject: Hands-on Roadshow: Streamline x Redwood — Bay Area pilot
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@streamline.ai>, Katie Monroe <katie@marigold.co>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hands-on Roadshow: Streamline x Redwood — Bay Area pilot

Hi Sam & Katie,

Thanks again for the intro, Katie — appreciated. Sam, great to meet you over email. Redwood would love to run a joint, in-person Bay Area pilot: a half-day "Hands-on Roadshow" where Streamline customers can bring a real dataset and Redwood + Streamline engineers help them prototype an inference pipeline and measure unit costs.

High-level ask:
- Partner marketing + demand: Streamline promotes to customers and we co-list on the event page.
- Venue + logistics: Marigold handles venue/resourcing for the day.
- Tech delivery: Redwood and Streamline provide one engineer each per 6 attendees.
- Budget: we’ll split A/V + venue costs; see attached SOW_estimate.xlsx for ballpark.

Proposed pilot date window: Sept 18–29 (we’re aiming for a Wednesday or Thursday). Draft agenda is attached (draft_agenda_v2.docx) — it’s intentionally hands-on: intro -> 2 workshop tracks -> lightning talks -> feedback round.

Next steps I propose:
1) Sam: confirm interest and share 2–3 pilot customers to invite.
2) Katie: confirm venue availability & ballpark cost.
3) Neha/Laura: we’ll coordinate marketing assets and run-of-show.

I’ve attached a one-pager we can share as a teaser (redwood_streamline_onepager.pdf). If the dates look tight, we can also slot this into the Oct calendar.

Thanks — excited to collaborate.

—Michael
Michael Grant
Head of Field Partnerships | Redwood Inference
michael@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood_streamline_onepager.pdf, draft_agenda_v2.docx, SOW_estimate.xlsx

From: Sam Patel <sam@streamline.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>
Cc: Katie Monroe <katie@marigold.co>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hands-on Roadshow: Streamline x Redwood — Bay Area pilot

Michael — thanks, this looks promising.

We’re definitely interested in a joint, customer-facing workshop that is practical (not just slides). A few notes from our side:
- We can surface 3 customers for the pilot (two mid-market SaaS, one enterprise prospect). I’ll confirm names by Friday.
- For running live prototypes, we prefer attendees bring a sanitized export rather than live DB access — simplifies security.
- Sept 25 looks clean on our events calendar; prefer a Wednesday.

Logistics question for Marigold: what’s the typical capacity for a hands-on day and do you provide breakout A/V packages?

Also — curious on the mutual KPIs: how do you want to measure success? My suggestion: 1) 8–12 customers signed up, 2) >=60% trial activation within 30 days, 3) 2 opportunities > $50k pipeline created.

Happy to do a short sync with the three of you next week.

—Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Integrations | Streamline Analytics
sam@streamline.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@streamline.ai>, Katie Monroe <katie@marigold.co>
Date: 2028-06-05T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Hands-on Roadshow: Streamline x Redwood — Bay Area pilot

Thanks — I pulled the draft agenda and made a couple of edits to tighten timing (see attached). Notes:
- Recommend we open registration at 25 seats and cap at 20 for pilot (keeps engineering ratio healthy).
- Split tracks: (A) Latency/Cost optimization for embeddings pipelines, (B) End-to-end serving (security + infra).
- We should build a short pre-work checklist for attendees (data sanitize checklist + .csv size guidelines).

Budget: based on the SOW_estimate, venue + A/V + food comes to ~ $7.2k. If we split 50/50 that’s $3.6k each; Marigold, can you confirm venue fees?

Marketing: Neha — can you put together a hero image, a one-paragraph event blurb, and a 3-email drip (save the date / full agenda / last call)? I’ll map tasks into the mutual action plan and we’ll use the HubSpot link to track RSVPs.

If everyone agrees, let’s do a 30-minute sync Thursday 6/7 at 10am PT to lock dates and owners.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: draft_agenda_v2.docx (updated)

From: Katie Monroe <katie@marigold.co>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>, Sam Patel <sam@streamline.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-07T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hands-on Roadshow: Streamline x Redwood — Bay Area pilot

Hi all — Marigold can host Sept 25 at the Embarcadero Lab (capacity 40, includes power strips and two breakout rooms). Venue fee estimate: $7,000 for the day (includes on-site A/V tech). We can add a plated lunch option for +$18/attendee if desired.

We usually require a 30% non-refundable deposit; I can send a short confirmation and a DocuSign for the SOW. I’ll attach a sample venue contract to the HubSpot event record.

Michael/Laura/Neha: confirm that seating cap of 20 + 1 engineer per 6 attendees is final and I’ll move forward with holding the date.

Thanks — Katie
Katie Monroe
Partnerships & Events Lead | Marigold Events
katie@marigold.co
